notes: Plants are succulents rather than herbs, but functions well as a low raised garden bed

blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden rectangular planter box filled with dark soil. Inside are four different succulent plants arranged in a row: two bluish-green rosette succulents, one spiky upright succulent, and one rounded purple-green mottled succulent. Small wooden plant marker stakes are set along the front inner rim. The wood has a warm medium-brown finish with stylized beveled corner posts.
blind.from_above: A horizontally elongated rectangle framed in brown wood containing dark soil, inside of which are four distinct circular/rosette-shaped succulent plant heads and tiny rectangular marker tabs along the lower interior edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 to 1.2 feet tall (around shin/knee height of the figure) and roughly 3.5 to 4 feet long.
